answer.text: Manages funds as per client directions; client decides what/when to buy/sell; PM executes

explanation.text: The Logic: Non-discretionary PM needs client direction for each transaction; PM executes. The Trap: Independent decisions = discretionary; advice-only = advisory. Cross-Exam Context: Same distinction in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: For non-discretionary clients, keep documented approvals for every transaction.
